# Awesome WorkBuddy

> A community-curated, safety-conscious index of Tencent WorkBuddy resources.

Use these pages first:

- [Searchable resource directory](https://sandbaseai.github.io/awesome-workbuddy/): filter the curated collection by keyword and category.
- [Complete bilingual resource data](https://sandbaseai.github.io/awesome-workbuddy/resources.json): machine-readable titles, URLs, descriptions, sections, and categories for every curated entry.
- [Start Here](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/START_HERE.md): choose between tasks, Skills, MCP, Automation, and Enterprise Agent workflows.
- [Chinese README](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/README.md): curated resources, examples, and selection standards.
- [English README](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/README.en.md): the same collection in English.
- [Security checklist](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/SECURITY.md): review permissions, credentials, data flow, scripts, and irreversible actions before installation.
- [Original Skills](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/tree/main/skills): installable, auditable WorkBuddy Skills maintained by this repository.
- [Hosted Skill index](https://agent-skills.md/authors/sandbaseai): online listings for the four original Skills and their install paths.
- [Document Quality Review](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/tree/main/skills/document-quality-review): read-only review of document and delivery quality.
- [Skill Security Audit](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/tree/main/skills/skill-security-audit): pre-install review of permissions, credentials, dependencies, and data flow.
- [Source-backed Research Brief](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/tree/main/skills/source-backed-research-brief): decision briefs with traceable sources, conflict handling, and explicit uncertainty.
- [Curate WorkBuddy Resource](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/tree/main/skills/curate-workbuddy-resource): evidence-backed include, hold, or exclude decisions for candidate WorkBuddy resources.
- [Latest Skill archives](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/releases/latest): downloadable packages and server-computed SHA-256 digests.
- [Update feed](https://sandbaseai.github.io/awesome-workbuddy/feed.xml): RSS feed for new curation and directory updates.

## Ecosystem monitoring

- [Curated ecosystem ranking](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/ECOSYSTEM.md): refreshed GitHub stars, languages, and recent activity for reviewed repositories.
- [Unvetted discovery queue](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/DISCOVERIES.md): automatically found candidates that still require relevance, license, permission, and maintenance review.
- [Discovery audit records](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aaudit): evidence-backed include, hold, and exclude decisions for candidate resources.

## Contributing and community

- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): bilingual inclusion criteria, validation steps, and pull-request workflow.
- [Suggest a resource](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/issues/new/choose): structured issue forms for resources, Skills, and corrections.
- [Community discussion](https://github.com/sandbaseai/awesome-workbuddy/discussions/78): introductions, questions, and collaboration.

This is an independent community index, not a Tencent publication. Indexed or
listed resources are not automatically trusted or endorsed; inspect each
source, license, permission, and account term before use.
